# (a punct token value) to one scalar (a precedence level).
# The control-flow-token component's 42 fixtures are NOT inherited merely
# to preserve an old number (ACT §10.2).  The partitions below are
# derived from the actual precedence table.

column1: NOTE: the count is a MINIMUM.  The successor may add rows, but every
mandatory partition must be present and every mandatory row must be
#   EXPECTED_FIXTURE_IDS     the complete set of mandatory fixture ids
#   FIXTURE_SCHEMA           the column layout of the fixture file
#   FIXTURE_SOURCE_SHA256    the SHA-256 of the fixture file
# and MUST provide an INDEPENDENT witness that every mandatory fixture
# is actually EXECUTED.  The witness must not be produced by the same
# row-classification path that the differential exercises.
# WHY THE INDEPENDENT WITNESS IS MANDATORY HERE (ACT §7.5):
# the metadata residue probe of this ACT REPRODUCED a bypass in the
# closed control-flow-token qualification tool: an INDENTED unknown
# fixture row is silently skipped, so the unknown-id ledger never sees
# it and the differential reports STATUS=PASS.  That tool MUST NOT be
# reused as the sole proof authority for adversarial fixture
# completeness.  The successor therefore needs a SEPARATE witness that
# counts the executed rows and the observed ids by a DIFFERENT path
# (for example a row-counting harness that is not the fixture reader).
# UNKNOWN OR ADDITIONAL FIXTURE ROWS MUST BE REJECTED unless they are
# expressly authorised as metadata by a strict, unambiguous grammar.
# A row that is neither a mandatory fixture row nor an authorised
# metadata row is an ERROR, not a skip.
